title: Depth-exceedance probability depends only on the function
statement: Let $f, g : (\mathrm{Fin}\,n \to \mathrm{Bool}) \to \mathrm{Bool}$ be Boolean functions on $n$ variables that agree at every input, and fix a real parameter $p$ and a threshold $t \in \bbn$. Then the Bernoulli($p$) restriction probability of the event that a random restriction $\rho$ produces a restricted function of decision-tree depth strictly greater than $t$ is the same for $f$ as for $g$.
hypotheses_covered: f and g agree pointwise on every input
the depth threshold is strict (> t)
replaced:
If $f$ and $g$ agree pointwise, then for any $p\in\bbr$ and $t\in\bbn$ the Bernoulli
restriction probabilities of the events $\{\rho : \mathrm{dtDepth}(\mathrm{restrictFn}\,f\,\rho) > t\}$
and $\{\rho : \mathrm{dtDepth}(\mathrm{restrictFn}\,g\,\rho) > t\}$ are equal.
